name: Milk Crown
description: A frozen milk coronet rising from tomato-red enamel against black.
lighting: Crisp freezing strobe, glossy speculars on milk and enamel
subject: either
prompt: A glossy tomato-red enamel surface is covered by a thin sheet of white milk only millimetres deep. At its centre a milk splash has just risen into a wide coronet, a ring of evenly spaced thin spikes each tipped with one round bead, frozen in mid-air, its rim wide enough for something to stand inside it, while fine droplets hang above. The milk is opaque, glossy and pure white, catching the light in soft bright arcs. One crisp strobe freezes it all against black beyond the enamel's edge. The palette is tomato red, milk white and black, graphic and dramatic.
